newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - April 21.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - April 21.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Premier Lien Chan orders to revise laws to increase number of local councilors.
Second mainland Chinese ship, flying a national flag of Republic of China, enters southern Kaohsiung Harbour after 48-year ban on direct shipping links across Taiwan strait.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Four soldiers injured in fire at Taichung missile base.
Lu Jen-fa appointed as next public prosecutors general.
LIBERTY TIMES - Hong Kong gangsters smuggle drug into Taiwan.
16-year-old high school student rapes 12-year-old girl in school toilet.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Ruling Nationalist legislative caucus suspected of illegally benefitting Nationalist lawmakers.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Government agencies to discuss follow-up policies on direct shipping links between Taiwan and mainland China.
Finance ministry mulls allowing banks to invest in property market.
